## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D robot game for phones/tablets where the robot can receive only one command at a time, with missions, a freeform Sandbox mode, and robot customization.

## Requirements
- Responsive phone/tablet gameplay with touch controls.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained HTML game using Three.js from a CDN, with three guided missions and a 7×7 buildable Sandbox board.
- Added single-command movement, collectible stars, a switch/gate puzzle, robot color/face customization, sound toggle, and keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game UI, 3D scene, missions, Sandbox, controls, customization, and responsive layout in `index.html`.
- Started a local HTTP server and opened the game in Playwright.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/desktop.jpg`.

### Active
- Verify gameplay and responsive/mobile presentation; address any issues found.

### Blocked

## Next Move
1. Exercise mission flows and Sandbox interactions in the browser, checking console output.
2. Resize to a phone/tablet viewport and capture/inspect a current JPEG screenshot.
3. Fix any issues and review `git status` for uncommitted changes.
